descriptions.w3d_s20_load_script_8019e1a8: Appears to run a script loader on the stored Lua state with a constant name and return 0x80004005 on failure, else 0.
descriptions.w3d_s20_apply_user_value_8019f9ec: Appears to convert a value from the first Lua argument and pass it to virtual method 7 of the object held by the owner, returning 1.
descriptions.w3d_s20_forward_user_values_8019e7e8: Appears to read two userdata words from the Lua stack and forward them with a global record's fields to a helper, returning zero.
descriptions.w3d_s20_query_object_8019dd80: Appears to query the first object of a pair through virtual method 5 into an output and return the secondary address when found.
